Resubmitted.

**What changed:** The deterministic "Customer convenience termination present" check failed because my evidence quotes pointed only at the notice sub-clause (p0045) and the charge sub-clause, not at the operative grant. I re-cited Section 3.4's grant sentence (p0044 — "Customer may terminate this Agreement … for convenience …") as both the finding quote and the already_met evidence for the Customer convenience element, and moved the Vendor-side already_met evidence cleanly onto the 3.2 term-end/90-day mechanic (p0040), adding p0042 to paragraphIds to show IBM's only mid-term exit is for cause.

**Substance unchanged:** one surgical eight-word cap in Section 3.4(b) ("not to exceed three (3) months' charges"), fallback level, no refund, survival, or procedural extras added.
